key: A pile of loose rocks sits near the tracks.
en: A pile of loose rocks sits near the tracks.
ja: 線路のそばに崩れた岩の山がある。

key: They could be moved into the cart if it were empty.
en: They could be moved into the cart if it were empty.
ja: トロッコが空なら、そこに移せそうだ。

key: Empty the cart?
en: Empty the cart?
ja: トロッコを空にする?

key: Fill up the cart?
en: Fill up the cart?
ja: トロッコに積む?

key: They could probably be moved if a cart were nearby.
en: They could probably be moved if a cart were nearby.
ja: 近くにトロッコがあれば動かせそうだ。

key: VICTORIA: Good, I'm glad you were able to get it!
en: VICTORIA: Good, I'm glad you were able to get it!
ja: ヴィクトリア: よかった、取ってこられたのね!

key: So, I'm not sure, but I think that the weakest point is probably going to be...
en: So, I'm not sure, but I think that the weakest point is probably going to be...
ja: それで、確信はないんだけど、たぶん一番弱い場所は…

key: TITANIA: All right, good work, or something.
en: TITANIA: All right, good work, or something.
ja: ティタニア: はい、お疲れさま、って感じで。

key: It is seriously a miracle anyone got anything done down here.
en: It is seriously a miracle anyone got anything done down here.
ja: こんな場所で誰かが何かを成し遂げたなんて、本当に奇跡ね。

key: Anyway, I found our spot.
en: Anyway, I found our spot.
ja: とにかく、目当ての場所を見つけたわ。

key: There.
en: There.
ja: あそこ。

key: VICTORIA: ...In the middle of that outcrop.
en: VICTORIA: ...In the middle of that outcrop.
ja: ヴィクトリア: …あの岩の突き出た部分の真ん中。

key: Based on the change of pitch at that point, that outcrop is probably hollow.
en: Based on the change of pitch at that point, that outcrop is probably hollow.
ja: あの場所の音の変化からすると、その突き出た岩はたぶん中が空洞になってる。

key: I assume an old tunnel collapsed back there a long time ago.
en: I assume an old tunnel collapsed back there a long time ago.
ja: ずっと昔に古いトンネルが崩れたんだと思う。

key: VICTORIA: I'll load the cart up for it, and then can you try and steer it to that point?
en: VICTORIA: I'll load the cart up for it, and then can you try and steer it to that point?
ja: ヴィクトリア: トロッコに積んでおくから、それをあの場所まで操縦してもらえる?

key: ...Don't worry, I'll stay out of the way too.
en: ...Don't worry, I'll stay out of the way too.
ja: …心配しないで、わたしも邪魔にならないようにしてるから。

key: After this, hopefully we'll be home free!
en: After this, hopefully we'll be home free!
ja: これが終われば、きっともう大丈夫なはず!

key: TITANIA: Anyway, I'll get the explosives ready.
en: TITANIA: Anyway, I'll get the explosives ready.
ja: ティタニア: とにかく、爆薬の準備をしておくわ。

key: I've spent enough time with Julia to know what I'm doing, unfortunately.
en: I've spent enough time with Julia to know what I'm doing, unfortunately.
ja: ジュリアと一緒にいすぎて、こういうのに詳しくなっちゃったのよね、残念ながら。

key: Get the cart to that spot and we'll be out of here.
en: Get the cart to that spot and we'll be out of here.
ja: あの場所までトロッコを持っていけば、ここから出られるわ。

key: VICTORIA: Well, this looks like a mess...
en: VICTORIA: Well, this looks like a mess...
ja: ヴィクトリア: うわ、これはひどい有様ね…

key: VICTORIA: And I don't immediately see an exit.
en: VICTORIA: And I don't immediately see an exit.
ja: ヴィクトリア: それに、出口もすぐには見当たらないし。

key: Here I was hoping something could be easy for once.
en: Here I was hoping something could be easy for once.
ja: たまには簡単なことがあってもいいと思ったんだけどな。

key: Um, but look up there.
en: Um, but look up there.
ja: あ、でも、あそこ見て。

key: VICTORIA: Those are supposed to be explosives, right?
en: VICTORIA: Those are supposed to be explosives, right?
ja: ヴィクトリア: あれ、爆薬よね?

key: If we can find a way to get to those, maybe we'll find somewhere we can break through.
en: If we can find a way to get to those, maybe we'll find somewhere we can break through.
ja: あそこまで行く方法が見つかれば、突破できる場所が見つかるかも。

key: Let's start with that!
en: Let's start with that!
ja: まずはそこからね!

key: I'll look around for any weak points in the meantime!
en: I'll look around for any weak points in the meantime!
ja: その間に、弱そうな場所がないか探してみる!

key: TITANIA: I'm no expert, but I'm pretty confident that this is the least efficient mining system in the entire world.
en: TITANIA: I'm no expert, but I'm pretty confident that this is the least efficient mining system in the entire world.
ja: ティタニア: 専門家じゃないけど、これは世界一非効率な採掘システムだって断言できるわ。

key: TITANIA: Someone is clearly allergic to making things simple.
en: TITANIA: Someone is clearly allergic to making things simple.
ja: ティタニア: 誰かさんは物事を単純にすることにアレルギーでもあるみたいね。

key: Naturally, there's no obvious exit...
en: Naturally, there's no obvious exit...
ja: 案の定、はっきりした出口はなし…

key: Just those.
en: Just those.
ja: あれだけね。

key: TITANIA: So here's the plan:
en: TITANIA: So here's the plan:
ja: ティタニア: だから、作戦はこう:

key: You seem to be good at putting up with bullshit, so you deal with the rails and find a way up to those.
en: You seem to be good at putting up with bullshit, so you deal with the rails and find a way up to those.
ja: あなた、くだらないことに耐えるのが得意そうだから、線路を何とかしてあそこまで行く道を見つけて。

key: I'll use Aegislash to check the walls for any points that sound moderately hollow.
en: I'll use Aegislash to check the walls for any points that sound moderately hollow.
ja: わたしはギルガルドを使って、壁をチェックして、それなりに空洞っぽい音がする場所を探すわ。

key: TITANIA: And someday, maybe-- just maybe--
en: TITANIA: And someday, maybe-- just maybe--
ja: ティタニア: そしていつか、もしかしたら――もしかしたらだけど――

key: Something will be even a fraction less complicated than it actually needs to be.
en: Something will be even a fraction less complicated than it actually needs to be.
ja: 何かが、本来必要なほどには複雑じゃなくなる日が来るかもね。

key: TITANIA: But probably not.
en: TITANIA: But probably not.
ja: ティタニア: でも、たぶん来ないでしょうね。

key: I'm a lucky lion.
en: I'm a lucky lion.
ja: 俺はラッキーなライオンだ。

key: And now I'm gonna eat.
en: And now I'm gonna eat.
ja: さて、今から食事にしよう。

key: An old area map is posted here.
en: An old area map is posted here.
ja: 古いエリアマップが貼られている。

key: It doesn't seem to have been touched in ages.
en: It doesn't seem to have been touched in ages.
ja: 長い間、誰も手をつけていないようだ。

key: Skip minecart puzzle?
en: Skip minecart puzzle?
ja: トロッコパズルをスキップする?

key: Teleport to other side?
en: Teleport to other side?
ja: 反対側にテレポートする?

key: Return to start?
en: Return to start?
ja: 最初の場所に戻る?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
